note: Both sets capture the core elevations (Finished Floor 2' - 9 1/2" above Grade Level 0' - 0") and the 3/8" = 1'-0" scales for the West (C1) and East (A1) module sections, and both repeat those same facts several times. Set B additionally extracts the full revision table (marks 1-5 with dates and descriptions) and the project/lot data, all of which match the title block, whereas Set A adds a claim conditioned on "Section B", which is only a grid-line letter on the page and not a section. Set B therefore has more correct, faithful claims and no misbound values, while Set A's only extra non-administrative content is that unsupported condition; Set B's weakness is slightly heavier duplication of the scale and elevation facts.
remarks: Both extractions restate the same two elevations and the section scales three or more times under slightly different entity/attribute spellings (e.g. 'elevation' vs 'height above grade level', 'scale' vs 'drawing scale'), a deduplication problem in the pipeline. The text layer is heavily out of reading order (grid letters, dimension strings and title-block fields interleaved), which likely caused Set A's 'Section B' condition. Neither set notes that the GENERAL SHEET NOTES and SHEET KEYNOTES boxes appear empty on the page, and neither captures the A1 (East Module) scale as its own named claim beyond the shared 3/8" = 1'-0" value.
